verdict.rationale: Jeeves is a fintech/expense-management product with an MCP server and payment scheduling for one-off future-dated payments, but no evidence shows support for recurring/scheduled automated jobs or workflows (e.g., cron-like recurring payments, recurring reimbursements, or scheduled agent tasks). The 'schedule for a future date' feature (jeeves-docs-30) is a single one-time future payment, not a recurring job scheduler.
